audit.whatIsWrong: Full layer read Skill/Skill/Skill/Skill/Skill/Skill/Cassiopeia while content win[] read Hwei/Hwei/Hwei/Cassiopeia/Cassiopeia/Cassiopeia/Hwei — every row disagreed, and the last row disagreed on the winner outright.
audit.why: packet.levelChart matches content win[] exactly. It is coherent with the kits: Hwei out-ranges Noxious Blast (850) and Twin Fang (700) before she has an ultimate, she takes 4-6 on Twin Fang sustain plus Petrifying Gaze, and Hwei retakes the two-item row on 1300-range R against a champion with no dash.
audit.corrected: phases[0..2].side = Hwei, phases[3..5].side = Cassiopeia, phases[6].side = Hwei, with whys[3..6] and phases[3..6].why rewritten so the sentence agrees with the verdict.

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[2] attributed Petrifying Gaze to level 3 and whys[3] attributed it to levels 4-5 — she does not have her ultimate before level 6. whys[2] also described her flipping trades on a row the chart awards to Hwei.
audit.why: Petrifying Gaze is the R (825 range, 120/100/80). The real 4-5 spike is Noxious Blast on a 3.5-second cooldown plus a self-healing Twin Fang at 0.75 seconds, which is what actually out-sustains chip poke.
audit.corrected: whys[2] now states the level-3 reason Hwei owns the row; whys[3] names the 3.5s Q and 0.75s Twin Fang instead of an ultimate she does not have.

audit.whatIsWrong: The single decisive interaction in this matchup was never stated: Petrifying Gaze stuns only enemies FACING Cassiopeia and merely slows anyone with their back turned. The page instead said the ult "stuns and grounds you" (it does not ground) and built the matchup around Miasma's grounding, which is worth nothing against a champion with no dashes. Hwei's own abilities were misnamed as "EE fear", "EQ root" and "W root/charm".
audit.why: Riot's text: "stunning any enemies in front of her that are facing her and slowing any others with their back turned." Miasma's text: "slowing, grounding, and lightly damaging" — Hwei's kit contains no dash, so the grounding clause is inert and the slow is the real threat. ownerKit lists E sub-abilities Grim Visage / Gaze of the Abyss / Crushing Maw (EQ/EW/EE) and W sub-abilities Fleeting Current / Pool of Reflection / Stirring Lights — no root and no charm.
audit.corrected: Walk away from her rather than backpedalling toward her and the ultimate is a slow, not a stun. Miasma grounds nothing you own; dodge it for the slow. Grim Visage (EQ) is the fear and the only 'no' button.

audit.whatIsWrong: Twin Fang's heal drives the whole mid-lane loss band and anti-heal appeared only once, in a misgendered report line.
audit.why: missingInteractions flags needs-antiheal: "Cassiopeia sustains through chip damage (Twin Fang (E)) — Grievous Wounds timing decides extended trades." Twin Fang is a 0.75-second cooldown that heals her for a percentage of damage dealt.
audit.corrected: Anti-heal now appears in breakdown.cooldowns, breakdown.feeding and wants.you[1] with the 0.75s cooldown attached.

audit.whatIsWrong: 24 lint hits: Cassiopeia is called "he/his/him" across tldr, winCon, tradeGood, tradeBad, ahead, two phases whys, breakdown.wave, breakdown.trading, four dos/donts titles and bodies, and eight report entries. dosFull[1].d was tradeGood verbatim and dontsFull[2].d was tradeBad verbatim. breakdown.cooldowns had no digit.
audit.why: champ-gender.js lists cassiopeia as female; the owner is addressed as "you", so every third-person pronoun on the page refers to her.
audit.corrected: All flagged fields regendered. Report entries were fixed with pronoun-only swaps to stay inside the sweep exclusion; the eight non-report fields were rewritten with kit-grounded content.

audit.why: packet.suspectNames flags "Petrifying Gaze" in wants.foe[1] and whys[3] as probable wrong names. It is a false positive — Petrifying Gaze is the correct name of Cassiopeia's R per packet.enemyAbilities. The real defect in whys[3] was the level, not the name.
audit.corrected: Name left as-is; the level error was corrected instead.

notes: Chart: the full layer disagreed with content win[] on all seven rows, including the winner of the last row (full said Cassiopeia, content said Hwei). Sides now match content and packet.levelChart; no win[] edits were possible because win[] was already correct. Ratings left at 5/5/5/5/6/6/6 — not renumbered, no kit basis. The biggest content win here is Petrifying Gaze's facing check, which was absent from the page and is stated verbatim in Riot's text; the page had instead built the matchup around Miasma's grounding, which does nothing to a champion with no dash. I did NOT repeat the page's claim that Cassiopeia "lacks boots (permanently grounded)" — her kit text says only "All Move Speed bonuses are more effective on Cassiopeia", the boots restriction is not in the data I was given, and "permanently grounded" is not what grounding means. Recorded as unverified rather than restated. packet.suspectNames flagged "Petrifying Gaze" twice as a probable fabrication; it is a false positive — that is the real R name per packet.enemyAbilities. Report entries were touched with pronoun-only swaps because lint flagged eight of them for misgendering; no report entry was rewritten for content, per the sweep exclusion.
